description: LP-dual stability scan for the pn-mixing α in the inter-nucleon crossing (1, −α·HA).  Three probes: (a) D tower binding B_pred(α) on a fine α grid; (b) single-block H_3 LP dual (γ, σ₀, σ₁, L₊, L₋, e⁻) shadow prices; (c) TOWER-LEVEL tests: ∂B/∂α numerical derivative + adjacent-pair SDP PSD sweep.  Tests whether α = ½ is picked out by stability (active-set change, degenerate y₀, ∂B/∂α zero-crossing, tight pair PSD transition, or minimum |B_pred − B_AME|).
